global: This is a bowl of miso ramen, its rich, golden broth glowing warmly under soft lighting. Topped with chashu pork, menma, and corn, the ingredients are artfully arranged in a white bowl with blue floral patterns, set against a wooden table.

regions.background: The table is a smooth, reddish-brown wooden surface with visible grain patterns and a warm, slightly reflective finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with blue floral and Japanese text patterns along its rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is vibrant orange-yellow, smooth with visible noodles and toppings, forming a circular pool with slight surface ripples.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth surface, slightly curved bowl, and rounded tip, partially submerged in ramen broth.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: golden-brown, tender-looking slices with crispy edges and visible fat marbling, slightly curled at the ends.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, sliced pieces with visible fibrous texture and curved, irregular edges.
